domain(person,[adelina,elian]).

% Adelina writes poetry.
axiom(s1, writes_poetry(adelina)).

% If Adelina excels at art, then she will gain recognition and earn acclaim.
axiom(s2, rule([excels_at_art(adelina)], and(gains_recognition(adelina), earns_acclaim(adelina)))).

% If Adelina either provides guidance or offers feedback (but not both), then she is supportive.
axiom(s3, rule([xor(provides_guidance(adelina), offers_feedback(adelina))], supportive(adelina))).

% Elian either shares her experiences or listens to others, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(shares_experiences(elian), listens_to_others(elian))).

% If someone values opinions and respects perspectives, then they listen to others.
axiom(s5, rule([values_opinions(X), respects_perspectives(X)], listens_to_others(X))).

% Adelina has imagination.
axiom(s6, has_imagination(adelina)).

% If Adelina has imagination, then she either thinks outside the box or solves problems creatively, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([has_imagination(adelina)], xor(thinks_outside_the_box(adelina), solves_problems_creatively(adelina)))).

% Adelina is willing to help.
axiom(s8, willing_to_help(adelina)).

% Adelina solves problems creatively.
axiom(s9, solves_problems_creatively(adelina)).

% If Adelina pursues artistic interests, then she either develops a unique voice or cultivates an original style, but not both.
axiom(s10, rule([pursues_artistic_interests(adelina)], xor(develops_a_unique_voice(adelina), cultivates_an_original_style(adelina)))).

% Adelina either shares her experiences or listens to others, but not both.
axiom(s11, xor(shares_experiences(adelina), listens_to_others(adelina))).

% Adelina is innovative.
axiom(s12, innovative(adelina)).

% Adelina is not supportive.
axiom(s13, not(supportive(adelina))).

% If Elian either provides guidance or offers feedback (but not both), then she is supportive.
axiom(s14, rule([xor(provides_guidance(elian), offers_feedback(elian))], supportive(elian))).

% Anyone who has experience or is willing to help can provide guidance.
axiom(s15, rule([or(has_experience(X), willing_to_help(X))], provides_guidance(X))).

% If Adelina is innovative, then she either harnesses her creativity or thinks outside the box, but not both.
axiom(s16, rule([innovative(adelina)], xor(harnesses_her_creativity(adelina), thinks_outside_the_box(adelina)))).

% Elian solves problems creatively.
axiom(s17, solves_problems_creatively(elian)).

% If Adelina harnesses her creativity, then she develops a unique voice and gains recognition.
axiom(s18, rule([harnesses_her_creativity(adelina)], and(develops_a_unique_voice(adelina), gains_recognition(adelina)))).

% If Adelina writes poetry, then she can either gain recognition or inspire others, but not both.
axiom(s19, rule([writes_poetry(adelina)], xor(gains_recognition(adelina), inspires_others(adelina)))).

% For anyone who gathers knowledge and builds connections, they can share their experiences.
axiom(s20, rule([gathers_knowledge(X), builds_connections(X)], shares_experiences(X))).

% Everyone who mentors apprentices either provides guidance or shares knowledge (or both).
axiom(s21, rule([mentors_apprentices(X)], or(provides_guidance(X), shares_knowledge(X)))).

% Elian has imagination.
axiom(s22, has_imagination(elian)).

% Adelina either offers feedback or listens to others, but not both.
axiom(s23, xor(offers_feedback(adelina), listens_to_others(adelina))).
